Messages.Author: David McCarty
Messages.Body:
Is the pool lost cumulative?

Can multiple copies be burned by the removal of one vampire.

Raille.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> Is the pool lost cumulative?

Yes

> Can multiple copies be burned by the removal of one vampire.

No. Each card requires it's own action to burn.
Just think about every other card that you can put down in mass
quantaties. Can you burn multiple copies of them with one action?
Multiple Anarchs with 1 vote?
Multiple Army of Rates (whose pool loss is not cumulative) with
1 action?

Sorrow
